desc.en: The mass of residual gas based on RF and N.
desc.ja: RF（相対充填量）と回転数から求める残留ガス質量。CSL の充填量演算に効く。

desc.en: The reference flow (mg/min) of the TETV valve when fully open.
Sets the time-constant for the first-order low-pass that smooths the exhaust pressure estimate. Larger = more smoothing/slower response; smaller = less smoothing/faster response.
Lower bound for filtered exhaust pressure. If p_abgasdruck_filter falls below this value, p_abgasdruck is forced to it.
Upper bound for filtered exhaust pressure. If p_abgasdruck_filter rises above this value, p_abgasdruck is forced to it.
Outputs the exhaust-gas pressure offset over ambient (p_abgasdruck - P_UMG) as a function of load.
desc.ja: 負荷に対する排気背圧の大気圧からのオフセット（p_abgasdruck − P_UMG）を出力する。

desc.en:
Configures the residual gas model to use.
0: table lookup (rg_m_lookup). 1: dynamic calc (p_abgasdruck_calc + rg_m_calc).
Specific gas constant for dry air.
desc.ja: 残留ガス演算に使う気体定数。KF_RG_M と組で効く。

desc.en: Swept volume of motor in cm3.
desc.ja: 1気筒あたりの行程容積。残留ガス質量の算出に使う。

desc.en: Number of cylinders in a bank.
Lower bound for total residual-gas mass.. If the computed rg_m falls below this value, its forced to k_rg_m_min.
Upper bound for total residual-gas mass.. If the computed rg_m rises above this value, its forced to k_rg_m_max.
Adds a phase offset to AVAN1_IST before the as gain lookup and as-window time calc. Use to align the models effective closing-flank region to the mechanical/measurement zero.
Minimum allowable calculated molar mass for residual gas mass calculations.

Defines whether or not RF is to be calculated from HFM. It should be noted that hardware changes would be required to implement an HFM for 0401. Furthermore it appears other changes were subsequently made to 0401 which renders setting this config to 1 non-operable.

0 = RF not calculated from HFM
1 = RF calculated from HFM

Defines how RF_SK_WDK1 and RF_SK_WDK2 should be calculated in situations where WDK_MODE < 2.

0 = Derived from rf_soll
1 = Derived from AQ_REL

This is more commonly known as the "CSL Alpha-N Map". This is the main volumetric efficiency table for the 0401 code.

X Axis: N (rpm)
Y Axis: aq_rel_rf (Note: This is a modified version of AQ_REL)
Z Axis: RF

This is more commonly known as the "CSL Alpha-N Cold Map". This is the cold-start volumetric efficiency table for the 0401 code.

X Axis: N (rpm)
Y Axis: aq_rel_rf (Note: This is a modified version of AQ_REL)
Z Axis: RF

This is more commonly known as the "CSL Alpha-N Flap Adder Map". This is the additive component to the volumetric efficiency table when the CSL snorkel flap is open.

X Axis: N (rpm)
Y Axis: aq_rel_rf (Note: This is a modified version of AQ_REL)
Z Axis: RF

Used when desired cylinder fill (rf_soll) is increasing. A lower value slows the response and smooths airflow changes; a higher value allows faster load buildup. Used in first-order filtering to blend between previous and new values.

X Axis: N (rpm)
Y Axis: RF
Z: -

Used when desired cylinder fill (rf_soll) is decreasing. A lower value smooths transitions and slows response; a higher value allows faster decay. Used in first-order filtering to blend between previous and new values.

Factor used to adjust AQ_REL to aq_rel_rf which is the modified AQ_REL value used as an input into kf_rf_soll and its companion tables. The result is used as a divisor so values less than 1.0 have the effect of making aq_rel_rf greater than AQ_REL.

X Axis: N (rpm)
Y Axis: -

k_rf_cfg is used to configure the behaviour of the RF calculation.

0x00: use rf_soll (with TABG adjustment)
0x01: use rf_p_saug 
0x04: use rf_hfm1 
0x10: use rf_soll (with TABG adjustment) + rf_p_saug_i
This parameter defines the RF value to be used when the vehicle is in Operating Mode B_START.
This parameter defines the ML value to be used when the vehicle is in Operating Mode B_START.
This parameter specifies the minimum temperature TMOT must be in order for k_rf_p_saug_i (the integrator component of RF based on p_saug (manifold absolute pressure)).

The calculation of rf_p_saug_i is only performed if a certain amount of time has passed since the motor reached N_START_EXIT (which is the engine rpm that must be attained in order for the motor to exit the "START" condition and get to the "LL" (idle) condition). This parameter specifies what this time is.
The integral component rf_p_saug_i needs to be limited in order to prevent integrator wind-up conditions. This parameter specifies the minimum (maximum negative) value for rf_p_saug_i.
The integral component rf_p_saug_i needs to be limited in order to prevent integrator wind-up conditions. This parameter specifies the maximum value for rf_p_saug_i.
In the event that there is a WDK error rf_p_saug_i is ramped to zero at the rate of k_rf_p_saug_i_begr per 10ms.
A multiplicative factor that is applied to the calculated rf_diag_f_max and rf_diag_f_min when KATH_ST is active.
A multiplicative factor that is applied to the calculated rf_diag_f_max and rf_diag_f_min when VAN_ED_ST is active.
The latch threshold for the RF-diagnostic counter. The rf_diag_counter is incremented by k_rf_diag_zaehler for as long as the error state persists and is latched once it reaches K_RF_DIAG_SCHWELLE.
The value to increment rf_diag_counter by each time an rf_diag error persists.

Sets the absolute accelerator-pedal delta/rate threshold above which the RF diagnostic is gated. When D_PWG exceeds this value, the routine resets rf_diag_counter to k_rf_diag_tau and temporarily inhibits fault detection to avoid transient tip-in/tip-out effects. Higher values reduce gating, lower values increase it.

Sets the re-enable delay for the RF diagnostic. When a gating condition is detected (e.g., large pedal delta, special catalyst/VANOS/ASC states), rf_diag_counter is reloaded to k_rf_diag_tau and counts down each scheduler tick. The diagnostic only resumes once it reaches zero.

The low-saturation threshold for the LAA controller outputs. When the RF error is latched out-of-band and both LAA_REGLER1 and LAA_REGLER2 drop below this value, the code flags the controller as bottomed out (via rf_diag_laa_st, e.g., sets the low-side bits depending on error sign). It doesnt trigger the fault itself, it classifies the condition once the fault is active.

The high-saturation threshold for the LAA controller outputs. When the RF error is latched out-of-band and both LAA_REGLER1 and LAA_REGLER2 drop below this value, the code flags the controller as maxed out (via rf_diag_laa_st, e.g., sets the high-side bits depending on error sign). It doesnt trigger the fault itself, it classifies the condition once the fault is active.

The curve that gives the upper/positive tolerance for the RF error rf_diag_f = rf_soll - rf_p_saug. The diagnostic treats rf_diag_f as out of band on the positive side when it exceeds this value.


X Axis: p_kvd (mbar)
Y Axis: - (mbar)

The curve that gives the lower/negative tolerance for the RF error rf_diag_f = rf_soll - rf_p_saug. The diagnostic treats rf_diag_f as out of band on the negative side when it exceeds this value.

X Axis: p_kvd (mbar)
Y Axis: - (mbar)

Maps the internal TOG oil-level index to the CAN message value used by the cluster. Adjust this curve to change how the measured oil level is displayed on the dash.

Minimum number of samples to average for the rest/settled oil level (rp) reading before its accepted as valid (taken when vehicle is stationary/low AX-AY). Higher = more stable but slower; lower = quicker but noisier.
Oil level longitudinal correction (V=0). Curve adds a bias to the computed oil level when the vehicle is stationary based on summed longitudinal acceleration.

Number of correction-loop cycles to wait after entering the measurement phase or after a motion/pressure disturbance before collecting rest/settled oil-level samples. Higher = longer settling time, fewer false readings; lower = faster learning but more risk of motion bias.
Maximum permitted change between successive TOG pulse periods. Larger jumps are treated as glitches and reset the diagnostic dwell; smaller jumps are accepted.
Maximum allowed lateral acceleration magnitude for rest/settled (RP) level learning. If ASC_AY >= this threshold, RP averaging is inhibited/reset so cornering doesnt bias the learned level.
Maximum allowed longitudinal acceleration magnitude for rest/settled (RP) level learning. If ASC_AX >= this threshold, RP averaging is inhibited/reset so cornering doesnt bias the learned level.
Max allowed change in engine speed N40 between consecutive samples to treat RPM as stable during the rest/settled (RP) phase
Minimum number of consecutive valid TOG pulses required before the ECU updates/confirms the oil-level diagnostic state.
Number of iterations N40 must remain within +/- k_tog_rp_n40_delta_max of the previous value before RPM is deemed stable and the TOG error/debounce counter is cleared.
The amount of time that the sport button needs to be held down to trigger displaying the oil level sensor reading on the dash.
The minimum number of valid TOG level samples that must be accumulated before committing a new oil level estimate.
A fixed subtraction applied to coolant temperature (TMOT) before the modeled oil-temp calculation, reducing how strongly TMOT drives the estimated oil temperature.

Modelled TABG based on N and RF.

Multiplier vs p_saug/p_egbp that raises residual re-breathing when backpressure dominates and reduces it when intake wins.
Effective molar mass of the residual mix as a function of intake cam phase.
Temperature-density multiplier used to turn manifold pressure into a density-like term for the residual-gas model.

nodes.name: rf_p_saug_i_calc
nodes.plate:
Calculates rf_p_saug_i which is an integral feedback loop component used to adjust RF (relative fill) from the CSL AlphaN table to remove error between the value from the AlphaN table and actual manifold vacuum.

Input variables: TMOT, ZUSTAND_MOTOR, KATH_ST, VAN_ED_ST, P_UMG_DIAG_ST, rf_diag_ed_st (error status flag byte that feeds into RF calculation), RF_DYN_ST, SSP_DIAG_ST, SYS_TIMERTICKS_COUNTER, n_start_exit_time (timertics since N_START_EXIT was reached), N, p_kvd (manifold vacuum pressure), RF

Output variables: rf_p_saug_i (RF integral controller component based off measured manifold vacuum)

Global Variables explained:
rf_diag_ed_st: a number of different rf diag error states are relevant to the RF calculation. This status byte is maintained based on the presence, or not, of errors.

n_start_exit_time: The calculation of rf_p_saug_i is contingent on it having been a certain amount of time (k_rf_p_saug_i_ll_wait) since N_START_EXIT was reached. n_start_exit_time records SYS_TIMERTICS_COUNTER at the time N_START_EXIT was reached.

p_kvd: Pressure Krümmervakuumdruck (Manifold Vacuum Pressure). This is calculated as P_UMG_FILTER - p_saug (manifold absolute pressure)

This function is run in the 10ms task

nodes.name: Find_Position_of_MSB
nodes.plate:
This function calculates the position of the most significant bit (MSB) that is set to 1 in the input param_1. Here's how:

Right shifts param_1 until it becomes 0.
Each shift reduces param_1, and the function counts how many shifts are required to clear all bits.
The return value 0x1f - uVar1 represents the position of the MSB in the 32-bit integer (because it starts at 0x1f or 31 in decimal, which is the highest bit position in a 32-bit value).

nodes.name: sys_cancel_task
nodes.plate:
* sys_cancel_task - Cancels a delayed (scheduled) task if present in the scheduler queue.
 *
 * @param task_id: The ID of the task to cancel (0–31).
 *
 * @return byte: Status code.
 *         - 0x00: Task successfully cancelled.
 *         - 0x22: Task was not scheduled; no action taken.
 *
 * Description:
 * If the given task is currently marked as scheduled (bit 0 set in its control byte),
 * this function searches the scheduler's delay queue (up to 8 slots) to find the task entry.
 * If found, it:
 *   - Clears the task's countdown timer.
 *   - Clears the task ID from the entry.
 *   - Clears the scheduled flag (bit 0) in the task's control byte.
 * 
 * If the task is not marked as scheduled, the function logs an error using `syserror`
 * and returns status 0x22.
 *
 * Interrupts are masked during table modification to ensure thread safety.

nodes.name: ask_flap_driver_open
nodes.plate:
Flap Open Event Handler
- Drives the actuator in the "open" direction for a calibrated duration (event timer).
- When timer expires, stops actuator output and sets the "flap open/actuated" state flag.

nodes.name: ask_flap_driver_close
nodes.plate:
Flap Close Event Handler
- Drives the actuator with the "close" command for a set duration (event timer).
- When the timer expires, stops actuator output and clears the "flap open/actuated"

nodes.name: ask_st_calc
nodes.plate:
CSL Intake Flap State Machine (runs every 100 ms)

 - Stepped state machine for managing actuator tests, position validation, and diagnostic checks.
 * - Controls timers and flags for event sequencing, actuator output, error handling, and test reporting.
 - Ensures that the flap can be opened/closed as commanded, validates plausibility of the flap position sensor,
    and triggers error recovery or resets as needed.
 - Uses a state variable (DAT_00ffdc99) to sequence through test/monitor states.
 - Coordinates with actuator output, diagnostic timer, and DTC logic to ensure system robustness.

nodes.name: ask_diag
nodes.plate:
CSL Flap Diagnostic/Test Mode Handler
Called from main flap state machine during diagnostic or test operation

- Manages diagnostic cycle sequencing, plausibility checks, and actuator commands when in a special test/diag mode.
- Interacts with timers, counters, and filter outputs to validate flap response and plausibility.
- Uses status and counter variables for debouncing, cycle timing, and recovery from error/test conditions.

nodes.name: ask_flap_driver_ed
nodes.plate:
Flap Actuator Driver Safety/Diagnostic Check
- Verifies the actuator driver hardware is enabled before allowing output
- If not enabled, logs a diagnostic fault (DTC_12_CSL_FLAP_DRIVER)
- Updates internal diagnostic state for subsequent logic/clearing
- Always called before setting actuator outputs

nodes.name: lsh_ELU_Driver_Diagnostics
nodes.plate:
The SLP driver HIP81 from Harris can diagnose the following errors:
- open load = interruption
- Short circuit to UB
- Short circuit to ground
- Overtemperature
The driver status is read out synchronously with the angle (every 720 °CA) and "averaged" over 100 msec. In the
background task, the driver status is checked for errors and the error evaluation routine is called.
This routine is called ed_report(unsigned char error, unsigned char errortype).
The routine enters the error into the error memory after a certain error frequency.

The transfer parameters for the error type to ed_report are the following values:
0x00: no mistake
0x01: short to battery
0x02: short to ground
0x04: open load
0x08: overtemperature

nodes.name: Find_Position_of_MSB
nodes.plate:
This function calculates the position of the most significant bit (MSB) that is set to 1 in the input param_1. Here's how:

Right shifts param_1 until it becomes 0.
Each shift reduces param_1, and the function counts how many shifts are required to clear all bits.
The return value 0x1f - uVar1 represents the position of the MSB in the 32-bit integer (because it starts at 0x1f or 31 in decimal, which is the highest bit position in a 32-bit value).

glossary._comment: MSS54 のドイツ語ニーモニック用語集。パラメータ名の意味を推測する助けとして UI のツールチップに出す。翻訳ではなく解説なので、原語は必ず併記すること。
glossary.RF: relative Füllung — 相対充填量（負荷）
glossary.WDK: Winkel Drosselklappe — スロットル開度
glossary.PWG: Pedalwertgeber — アクセルペダルセンサー
glossary.EDK: Elektronische Drosselklappe — 電子スロットル
glossary.EGAS: Elektronisches Gaspedal — 電子アクセル
glossary.PDR: Pedal-Drossel-Referenz — ペダル→スロットル特性
glossary.LSHV: Lambdasondenheizung vor Kat — 触媒前O2センサーヒーター
glossary.LSHN: Lambdasondenheizung nach Kat — 触媒後O2センサーヒーター
glossary.KR: Klopfregelung — ノックコントロール
glossary.SA: Schubabschaltung — 減速時燃料カット
glossary.AVAN: Auslass-VANOS — 排気側可変バルブタイミング
glossary.EVAN: Einlass-VANOS — 吸気側可変バルブタイミング
glossary.DISA: Differenzierte Sauganlage — 可変吸気マニホールド
glossary.ASK: Ansaugklappe — 吸気フラップ（CSL スノーケル）
glossary.LLR: Leerlaufregler — アイドルレギュレータ
glossary.FGR: Fahrgeschwindigkeitsregelung — クルーズコントロール
glossary.TE: Tankentlüftung — タンク換気（エバポ）
glossary.LDP: Leckdiagnosepumpe — リーク診断ポンプ
glossary.EGBP: Exhaust Gas Back Pressure — 排気背圧
glossary.KAD: Kennfeld Ansaugdruck — 吸気圧マップ
glossary.SMG: Sequentielles M Getriebe — SMG トランスミッション
glossary.DTC: Diagnostic Trouble Code — 診断トラブルコード
glossary.TPU: Time Processor Unit — MC68336 のタイマ処理ユニット
glossary.QADC: Queued Analog-to-Digital Converter — A/D 変換器
glossary.SIM: System Integration Module — MC68336 のシステム統合モジュール
glossary.CTM4: Configurable Timer Module — 設定可能タイマモジュール
